title: Scripture and Suffering
definition: Scripture and Suffering means God’s Word speaks truth, comfort, endurance, and hope into pain, loss, weakness, and hardship.
summary: Scripture and Suffering means God’s Word speaks truth, comfort, endurance, and hope into pain, loss, weakness, and hardship.
christFocus: Jesus suffered for sinners, draws near to the suffering, and gives His people hope through His resurrection and promised restoration.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture is honest about suffering. It does not pretend pain is unreal or faith makes life easy. The Bible gives words for lament, grief, endurance, hope, and trust when life is heavy.

Suffering is not always explained in the way people want. Scripture does not answer every why, but it reveals who God is: near to the brokenhearted, sovereign over evil, faithful in weakness, and committed to final restoration.

Christ stands at the center of Scripture’s word to sufferers. He entered pain, bore sin, conquered death, and now intercedes for His people. Because of Him, suffering is not meaningless, and it will not have the final word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People in grief, disability, recovery, rejection, or chronic hardship need more than clichés. Scripture gives durable hope that can survive tears.

This doctrine corrects the harmful idea that suffering always means failure, punishment, or weak faith. Scripture shows that God can be present, purposeful, and faithful even in deep pain.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your suffering honestly before God through Scripture and prayer. Lament without pretending, hope without denying pain, and ask the Holy Spirit to help you endure with your eyes fixed on Christ.
